description: Enhanced native-disjoint success coverage for a minimal valid Vulkan-environment vertex shader targeting HLSL.

input.assembly:
OpCapability Shader
          OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450
          OpEntryPoint Vertex %main "main"
%void   = OpTypeVoid
%void_f = OpTypeFunction %void
%main   = OpFunction %void None %void_f
%label  = OpLabel
          OpReturn
          OpFunctionEnd
